metrics.raw_definition: Absolute perpendicular offset of the dial centre from the line through the detected 12-triangle centre and 6-baton centre, using pre-reliability landmark geometry.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same line-offset quantity after the existing dial, 12-chain and 6-baton reliability gates pass.

metrics.raw_definition: Absolute perpendicular offset of the dial centre from the line through detected 3- and 9-baton centres, using pre-reliability baton geometry.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same 3/9 line-offset quantity after the existing dial and baton repeatability gates pass.

metrics.raw_definition: Median radial position of all FOUND round-marker centres in the rectified dial frame, normalised by dial radius.
metrics.eligible_definition: Median radial position recomputed using only round markers that pass the existing resize-repeatability support gate.

metrics.raw_definition: RMS angular error of FOUND round-marker centres from their expected hour angles, referenced to the detected 12-minute-track direction.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same RMS definition recomputed using only round markers that pass the existing resize-repeatability support gate.

metrics.raw_definition: Tangential centring offset of the selected 12-triangle base midpoint from the local minute-track reference, divided by the triangle base width.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same centring quantity after the existing 12-chain and centring resize-repeatability gates pass.

metrics.raw_definition: Radial gap between the intended outer 12-triangle base edge and its local minute-track reference, normalised by dial radius.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same outer-edge gap quantity after the existing 12-chain and gap resize-repeatability gates pass.

metrics.raw_definition: Rotation of the selected 12-triangle base relative to the local 60-minute track reference, in degrees.
metrics.eligible_definition: The same rotation quantity after the existing 12-chain and rotation resize-repeatability gates pass.
